grammar: n. 四分之一；一刻钟；可数，复数 quarters。时间表达中 a quarter past seven 是七点一刻，a quarter to eight 是差一刻八点。
collocations: a quarter past seven; a quarter to eight; a quarter of an hour。
commonMistake: quarter past + 小时表示过了该点一刻；quarter to + 小时表示差一刻到该点。

example.english: My first class starts at a quarter past eight.
example.chinese: 我的第一节课八点一刻开始。

application.prompt: The clock shows 7:15. It is a quarter ___ seven. A. past B. to
application.solution: A。解析：7:15 是七点过一刻，用 a quarter past seven。

grammar: n. 淋浴；阵雨；v. 洗淋浴。可数名词，复数 showers；常用 take/have a shower。
collocations: take a shower; have a quick shower; shower gel。
commonMistake: 表示“洗淋浴”常说 take a shower；shower 作名词时单数前通常需要 a。

example.english: I take a shower after my morning run.
example.chinese: 我晨跑后洗淋浴。

application.prompt: After football practice, Ben takes ___ before dinner. A. a shower B. homework
application.solution: A。解析：运动后洗淋浴可以说 take a shower。

grammar: v. 刷；刷净；n. 刷子。作动词时 brush—brushed—brushed—brushing；第三人称单数 brushes。
collocations: brush your teeth; brush your hair; a toothbrush。
commonMistake: brush one's teeth 中 teeth 是 tooth 的复数；he/she 作主语时 brush 要加 -es：brushes。

example.english: She brushes her teeth before breakfast.
example.chinese: 她早餐前刷牙。

application.prompt: I use a toothbrush to ___ my teeth every morning. A. brush B. brushes
application.solution: A。解析：to 后接动词原形，使用 brush。

grammar: n. 牙齿；单数 tooth，复数 teeth，是不规则变化。常用 brush one's teeth。
collocations: a front tooth; brush your teeth; toothache。
commonMistake: tooth 的复数是 teeth，不是 tooths；说“刷牙”用 brush one's teeth。

example.english: The dentist says I should brush my teeth twice a day.
example.chinese: 牙医说我应该每天刷两次牙。

application.prompt: Brush your ___ after breakfast and before bed. A. tooth B. teeth
application.solution: B。解析：通常刷多颗牙齿，tooth 的复数形式是 teeth。

grammar: n. 职责；责任；可数或不可数。复数 duties；由辅音字母 + y 结尾时，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
collocations: be on duty; do your duty; a sense of duty。
commonMistake: duty 的复数是 duties，不是 dutys；on duty 表示“值班/当班”。

example.english: It is my duty to feed the dog every morning.
example.chinese: 每天早上喂狗是我的职责。

application.prompt: Mr Wu is helping students at the school gate today. He is on ___. A. duty B. shower
application.solution: A。解析：on duty 表示“值班”，符合老师在校门口工作的情境。

grammar: adv. 通常；一般。频度副词常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
collocations: usually get up; usually at home; usually goes to bed early。
commonMistake: usually 放在实义动词前，如 usually walk；放在 be 动词后，如 is usually busy。

example.english: I usually walk to school with my brother.
example.chinese: 我通常和哥哥一起步行上学。

application.prompt: I ___ get up at seven on school days. A. usually B. usual
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 get up 要用副词 usually；usual 是形容词。

examTags: 阅读·根据职责识别职业
grammar: n. 记者；可数，复数 reporters。由 report + -er 构成，-er 常表示做某种工作的人。
collocations: a news reporter; a TV reporter; a reporter for a newspaper。
commonMistake: reporter 是“记者”，report 是“报道/报告”或“报道”这个动词；注意区分人和工作内容。

example.english: The reporter asks the coach about the game.
example.chinese: 记者向教练询问比赛的情况。

application.prompt: A person who asks questions and writes news for a newspaper is a ___. A. reporter B. restaurant
application.solution: A。解析：采访并报道新闻的人是 reporter（记者）。

examTags: 词汇·介词与副词语境义
听读·理解大致时间和方位
grammar: prep./adv. 大约；在周围；环绕。表示大约的时间或数量时可放在数字前，如 around seven。
collocations: around seven o'clock; walk around the park; look around。
commonMistake: around + 时间可表示“大约”；around the room 表示“在房间周围/环顾四周”，根据后面的词判断意思。

example.english: The school bus arrives around eight in the morning.
example.chinese: 校车早上大约八点到。

application.prompt: The bus comes at about 7:30, but the time may change a little. It comes ___ 7:30. A. around B. exactly
application.solution: A。解析：about 7:30 表示“大约七点半”，可用 around 7:30。

examTags: 语言运用·描述学习安排
grammar: n. 家庭作业；通常作不可数名词，不加复数 -s；可说 a piece of homework。
collocations: do homework; finish your homework; a lot of homework。
commonMistake: homework 通常不可数，不说 a homework 或 homeworks；常用 do homework。

example.english: I finish my homework before dinner.
example.chinese: 我在晚饭前完成家庭作业。

application.prompt: How much ___ do you have tonight? A. homework B. homeworks
application.solution: A。解析：homework 通常不可数，不加复数 -s。

grammar: n. 谚语；格言；可数，复数 sayings。由 say + -ing 构成；say 是动词“说”。
collocations: an old saying; as the saying goes; a popular saying。
commonMistake: saying 作名词常指一句谚语或格言；say 是动词，句子中要按主语和时态变形。

example.english: My grandfather often uses an old saying to teach me a lesson.
example.chinese: 爷爷常用一句老话来教我道理。

application.prompt: “早睡早起身体好”是一句常见的 ___. A. saying B. reporter
application.solution: A。解析：简短表达生活道理的谚语或格言是 saying。

examTags: 阅读·理解日常作息与自然现象
grammar: v. 上升；起身；rise—rose—risen—rising。rise 通常不直接接宾语；表示“升起”可说 the sun rises。
collocations: rise early; the sun rises; rise from a chair。
commonMistake: rise 表示自己“升起/起身”，不直接带宾语；raise 表示“举起/提高”某物，后面要接宾语。

example.english: The sun rises before six in summer.
example.chinese: 夏天太阳六点前升起。

application.prompt: The sun ___ in the east every morning. A. rises B. raises
application.solution: A。解析：太阳自己升起用不及物动词 rise；raise 后需要接宾语。

examTags: 语言运用·描述状态和去留
grammar: v. 停留；保持。stay—stayed—stayed—staying；可作系动词，后接形容词表示“保持某种状态”。
collocations: stay at home; stay in bed; stay healthy; stay up late。
commonMistake: stay 作“保持”时后可直接接形容词，如 stay healthy；不需要再加 be。

example.english: I stay at school until my club meeting ends.
example.chinese: 我待在学校，直到社团活动结束。

application.prompt: You have a fever, so please ___ at home today. A. stay B. stays
application.solution: A。解析：please 引导祈使句，用动词原形 stay。

examTags: 写作·描述日常生活顺序
grammar: n. 常规；惯例；日常生活安排。可数，复数 routines；也可作形容词，表示“常规的”。
collocations: daily routine; morning routine; follow a routine。
commonMistake: routine 是名词“日常安排”，常说 my daily routine；不要与 reporter 等表示人的名词混淆。

example.english: My morning routine starts with breakfast.
example.chinese: 我的早晨日常安排从吃早餐开始。

application.prompt: The usual things you do each morning are your morning ___. A. routine B. homework
application.solution: A。解析：每天通常会做的一系列事情是 routine（日常安排）。

examTags: 词汇·生活场所与可数名词
grammar: n. 餐馆；餐厅；可数，复数 restaurants。单数前通常有 a/the 或物主限定词。
collocations: go to a restaurant; eat at a restaurant; a family restaurant。
commonMistake: restaurant 是可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词；拼写时注意中间的 au。

example.english: We have dinner at a small restaurant near the station.
example.chinese: 我们在车站附近的一家小餐馆吃晚饭。

application.prompt: People go to this place to order and eat meals. It is a ___. A. restaurant B. routine
application.solution: A。解析：点餐并用餐的场所是 restaurant（餐馆）。

grammar: 不可数名词，指打扫和整理家务；通常不加 a，也没有常规复数形式。
collocations: do housework；help with the housework；share the housework
commonMistake: housework 泛指家务劳动时作不可数名词，通常不说 a housework 或 houseworks。

example.english: I help with the housework after I finish my homework.
example.chinese: 做完作业后，我会帮忙做家务。

application.prompt: On Saturday, I help my parents do ___ at home.
application.solution: housework

examTags: 阅读能力·理解同时发生的动作
grammar: 可作名词，表示一段时间、片刻，常用于 for a while；也可作连词，表示“在……期间/当……时”，连接两个分句。
collocations: for a while；in a while；while I am doing...；while we wait
commonMistake: while 作连词时后接含主语和谓语的分句；表示“一段时间”常说 for a while。during 后接名词短语。

example.english: We talk for a while after dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭后我们聊了一会儿。

application.prompt: I read a book ___ my sister prepares dinner. (while / during)
application.solution: while

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: as, when or while

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与时间介词
grammar: 可数名词，表示周末；复数为 weekends。英式英语常说 at the weekend，美式英语常说 on the weekend；this weekend 前通常不加介词。
collocations: this weekend；at the weekend；on the weekend；weekend plans
commonMistake: at the weekend 和 on the weekend 分别常见于英式和美式英语；this weekend 通常不加 at/on。

example.english: We visit our grandparents every weekend.
example.chinese: 我们每个周末都去看望祖父母。

application.prompt: Saturday and Sunday together make up the ___.
application.solution: weekend

examTags: 词汇辨析·形容词与副词
grammar: 形容词，表示每日的或日常的，通常放在名词前作定语。
collocations: daily routine；daily exercise；daily life；daily activities
commonMistake: daily 是一个词，可作形容词或副词；every day 是两个词，常作时间状语表示“每天”。

example.english: A short daily walk helps me feel ready for school.
example.chinese: 每天短暂散步能让我做好上学的准备。

application.prompt: I take a ___ walk before school each day. (daily)
application.solution: daily

examTags: 阅读能力·理解范围限制
grammar: 副词，表示“只有/仅仅”；常放在所限定的词或短语之前，位置不同可能改变强调重点。
collocations: only one；only a few；only child；not only...but also...
commonMistake: only 通常靠近它所限定的内容；only one book 表示“只有一本书”。

example.english: I have only one club meeting today.
example.chinese: 我今天只有一次社团活动。

application.prompt: There is ___ one clean shirt left, so I need to do the laundry. (only)
application.solution: only

examTags: 语法知识·名词与不规则动词
grammar: 可作名词，表示休息或间断；也可作动词，表示打破或损坏，不规则变化为 break—broke—broken。
collocations: have a break；take a short break；break a cup；break a window
commonMistake: a break 可表示一次休息或间断；break 作“损坏”时过去式是 broke，过去分词是 broken。

example.english: We have a ten-minute break between lessons.
example.chinese: 两节课之间我们有十分钟的休息时间。

application.prompt: After two hours of study, I take a short ___.
application.solution: break

examTags: 语法知识·动词后接动词-ing
语言运用·任务与时间管理
grammar: 动词，表示完成；后接名词或动词-ing形式，如 finish homework、finish eating。
collocations: finish homework；finish doing sth；finish a task
commonMistake: finish 后接另一动作时通常用动词-ing，如 finish reading；不说 finish to read。

example.english: I finish my homework before I play hockey.
example.chinese: 我做完作业后再打曲棍球。

application.prompt: I always ___ my homework before dinner. (finish)
application.solution: finish

grammar: 名词，表示曲棍球运动，通常作不可数名词；可指场地曲棍球或冰球。
collocations: play hockey；a hockey stick；ice hockey；field hockey
commonMistake: 表示进行曲棍球运动通常说 play hockey，不在运动名称前加 a。

example.english: The students play hockey on the field after school.
example.chinese: 学生们放学后在球场上打曲棍球。

application.prompt: Players wear skates and use sticks to play ___ on ice. (hockey / tennis)
application.solution: hockey

examTags: 阅读能力·理解动作完成时间
grammar: 副词，表示“已经”；常用于肯定句，通常放在主要动词前、be 动词后或助动词与主要动词之间。
collocations: already finished；have already done；be already ready
commonMistake: already 常用于肯定句；在现在完成时中通常放在 have/has 与过去分词之间。

example.english: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
example.chinese: 我已经收拾好明天要用的书包了。

application.prompt: It is only seven, but Ben has ___ finished breakfast. (already / yet)
application.solution: already

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与比较级
语言运用·描述光线与时间
grammar: 形容词，表示黑暗的或颜色深的；比较级 darker，最高级 darkest。
collocations: get dark；in the dark；dark blue；a dark room
commonMistake: dark 是形容词，如 The room is dark；描述天气变暗可说 It gets dark。

example.english: It gets dark early in winter, so I come home before six.
example.chinese: 冬天天黑得早，所以我六点前回家。

application.prompt: There is no light in the room, so it is ___. (dark / bright)
application.solution: dark

examTags: 阅读能力·理解地点信息
grammar: 可作副词表示在外面，也可作介词，后接地点名词表示在……外面；还可作形容词，如 outside door。
collocations: go outside；play outside；outside the house；wait outside
commonMistake: outside 作介词时后接地点，如 outside the house；单独作副词时可说 Let's go outside。

example.english: The children play outside while their mother cooks dinner.
example.chinese: 妈妈做晚饭时，孩子们在外面玩。

application.prompt: It is sunny. Let's play ___ instead of staying indoors.
application.solution: outside

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与介词搭配
阅读能力·理解组成关系
grammar: 可数名词，表示部分或组成部分；常用 a part of，表示整体中的一部分。
collocations: a part of the day；part of my routine；play a part in
commonMistake: 表示“……的一部分”通常用 a part of；part-time 是另一个含义的复合词。

example.english: Breakfast is an important part of my morning routine.
example.chinese: 早餐是我早晨日常安排中的重要部分。

application.prompt: A short walk is one ___ of my daily routine. (part)
application.solution: part

examTags: 词汇辨析·合成形容词与时间短语
grammar: 形容词，表示日常的、普通的，通常放在名词前；every day 是两个词，作时间状语表示“每天”。
collocations: everyday life；everyday clothes；everyday activities
commonMistake: everyday 是形容词，如 everyday activities；表示“每天”要写 every day。

example.english: I wear comfortable clothes for everyday activities.
example.chinese: 日常活动时我穿舒适的衣服。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective meaning “ordinary”: my ___ clothes.
application.solution: everyday

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: every day or everyday

grammar: 动词，表示准备；可用 prepare for + 名词，prepare to do sth，或 prepare sth。规则变化为 prepared—prepared，进行时为 preparing。
collocations: prepare for school；prepare to leave；prepare breakfast；prepare a bag
commonMistake: 表示为某事做准备说 prepare for sth；表示准备做某事说 prepare to do sth。

example.english: I prepare my sports clothes the night before PE.
example.chinese: 体育课前一晚，我会准备好运动服。

application.prompt: We need to ___ for the hockey game tonight. (prepare)
application.solution: prepare

grammar: adj. 芬兰的；n. 芬兰语（通常不可数）。表示芬兰人通常说 a Finn 或 a Finnish person；国籍和语言名称首字母大写。
collocations: a Finnish student；the Finnish language；Finnish food
commonMistake: Finnish 可作形容词，也可指芬兰语；表示一个芬兰人通常说 a Finn 或 a Finnish person，不说 a Finnish。

example.english: A Finnish student joined our English class this term.
example.chinese: 这学期一位芬兰学生加入了我们的英语班。

application.prompt: A person or thing from Finland can be described as ___. (Finnish / Finland)
application.solution: Finnish。解析：Finland 是国家名；Finnish 作形容词表示“芬兰的/芬兰人的/芬兰语的”，作名词指“芬兰语”；一个芬兰人说 a Finn 或 a Finnish person。

grammar: adv. ……点钟。放在 1 至 12 的整点数字后表示时间；写作 o’clock，使用撇号。
collocations: at six o’clock；three o’clock in the afternoon；what time is it?
commonMistake: o’clock 表示整点，不用于 6:30 这类带分钟的时间；注意撇号位置。

example.english: Our first lesson begins at eight o’clock.
example.chinese: 我们的第一节课八点开始。

application.prompt: The clock shows exactly 9:00. It is nine ___. (o’clock / half)
application.solution: o’clock。解析：9:00 是九点整，用 nine o’clock。

grammar: n./det./pron. 一半；半个。常见结构有 half an hour（半小时）、half past six（六点半）和 half of the cake（一半蛋糕）。
collocations: half an hour；half past seven；half of the class
commonMistake: 表示几点半常说 half past + 小时；half an hour 中 hour 前用 an。

example.english: The film starts in half an hour.
example.chinese: 电影半小时后开始。

application.prompt: The clock shows 7:30. It is half ___ seven. (past / to)
application.solution: past。解析：英式时间表达中 7:30 是 half past seven。

grammar: n. 连衣裙；衣服；v. 穿衣。作名词时是可数名词；作动词时规则变化为 dress—dressed—dressed。
collocations: wear a dress；get dressed；dress in warm clothes
commonMistake: 表示“穿着某件衣服”常用 wear；get dressed 表示“穿好衣服”，不能说 get dress。

example.english: Ella wears a warm dress on cold school mornings.
example.chinese: 寒冷的上学早晨，埃拉会穿一条暖和的连衣裙。

application.prompt: Before school, Leo gets ___ and packs his bag. (dressed / dress)
application.solution: dressed。解析：固定表达是 get dressed，表示“穿好衣服”。

examTags: 语法知识·餐名的冠词用法
grammar: n. 早餐。谈论日常用餐时通常不加冠词；可说 have/eat breakfast 或 for breakfast。
collocations: have breakfast；eat breakfast；for breakfast；breakfast time
commonMistake: 泛指日常早餐时通常说 have breakfast，不说 have a breakfast；特定的一顿早餐也可用冠词。

example.english: I have breakfast at seven before school.
example.chinese: 我上学前七点吃早餐。

application.prompt: I usually ___ breakfast before I leave for school. (have / has)
application.solution: have。解析：主语 I 后用动词原形；固定表达为 have breakfast。

examTags: 语言运用·事件先后顺序
grammar: prep./conj./adv. 在……以前。后接名词或时间作介词，后接主谓完整的从句作连词，也可单独作副词。
collocations: before class；before dinner；before you leave
commonMistake: before 后接从句时，从句要有主语和谓语；表示将来时间时，before 从句中通常用一般现在时。

example.english: Please wash your hands before dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭前请洗手。

application.prompt: Wash your hands ___ you eat. Do it first, not afterwards. (before / after)
application.solution: before。解析：先洗手、后吃饭，所以用 before（在……以前）。

examTags: 语法知识·动词不定式与动名词
grammar: v. 开始。过去式 began，过去分词 begun；begin 后可接 to do 或 doing，通常都表示开始做某事。
collocations: begin a lesson；begin to read；begin doing homework
commonMistake: begin 的过去式是 began，过去分词是 begun；begin doing 和 begin to do 通常都可用。

example.english: The lesson began at nine yesterday.
example.chinese: 昨天这节课九点开始。

application.prompt: The film ___ at six yesterday, so we arrived early. (began / begun)
application.solution: began。解析：yesterday 表示过去，begin 的一般过去式是 began。

examTags: 语法知识·名词可数性与搭配
grammar: n. 正餐；晚餐。表示日常用餐时常用 have dinner，不加冠词；正式宴会或特定一餐也可作可数名词。
collocations: have dinner；cook dinner；after dinner；dinner time
commonMistake: 表示日常吃晚饭通常说 have dinner；不能把所有 dinner 都当作不可数名词，正式宴会可说 a dinner。

example.english: We have dinner together at six every evening.
example.chinese: 我们每天晚上六点一起吃晚饭。

application.prompt: We usually ___ dinner together at six. (have / has)
application.solution: have。解析：主语 We 后用动词原形，日常用餐表达为 have dinner。

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与副词
grammar: adj./adv. 早的；早地。比较级 earlier，最高级 earliest；作形容词修饰名词，作副词修饰动词。
collocations: get up early；arrive early；an early bus；early in the morning
commonMistake: early 可作形容词或副词，比较级和最高级分别是 earlier、earliest；soon 表示“不久”，含义不同。

example.english: We got up early to catch the first bus.
example.chinese: 我们早起去赶第一班公交车。

application.prompt: The first lesson starts at 8:00, so we should arrive ___. (early / late)
application.solution: early。解析：要赶上第一节课，应当提前到达。

examTags: 语法知识·动词与介词搭配
grammar: v. 问；请求。常用 ask sb. a question、ask sb. for sth.、ask sb. to do sth.；过去式和过去分词为 asked。
collocations: ask a question；ask for help；ask sb. to do sth.
commonMistake: 请求某物用 ask for sth.；向某人提问用 ask sb. a question，不在 ask 与人之间加 to。

example.english: I asked the teacher for help with my homework.
example.chinese: 我向老师求助，解决作业上的问题。

application.prompt: If you need a pencil, ask ___ one. (for / about)
application.solution: for。解析：想要别人给某物，用 ask for sth.。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: ask and ask for

examTags: 语法知识·餐名的冠词用法
grammar: n. 午餐。表示日常用餐时通常不加冠词；可说 have/eat lunch、for lunch，也可构成 lunch box。
collocations: have lunch；eat lunch；for lunch；lunch box
commonMistake: 泛指日常午餐时通常说 have lunch，不说 have a lunch；特定活动或宴请中的午餐可用冠词。

example.english: We have lunch at school at twelve.
example.chinese: 我们十二点在学校吃午饭。

application.prompt: At noon, the students have ___ in the dining hall. (lunch / breakfast)
application.solution: lunch。解析：中午吃的是午餐。

examTags: 阅读·理解影视活动信息
grammar: n. 电影；影片。表示一部电影时是可数名词，可说 a film 或 two films；作动词时表示拍摄影片。
collocations: watch a film；see a film；a film about animals
commonMistake: 表示“看一部电影”常说 watch/see a film；film 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a/an/the 等限定词。

example.english: Our class watched a film about life on a farm.
example.chinese: 我们班看了一部关于农场生活的电影。

application.prompt: At the cinema, we watched a ___ with moving pictures and a story. (film / lesson)
application.solution: film。解析：电影院放映的故事影片是 film（电影）。

grammar: n. 课；一节课；经验教训。表示课程时是可数名词，复数为 lessons；也可指从经历中得到的教训。
collocations: an English lesson；have a lesson；learn a lesson
commonMistake: 表示“一节课”时 lesson 是可数名词，单数前需有限定词，如 an English lesson。

example.english: Our English lesson begins at nine o’clock.
example.chinese: 我们的英语课九点开始。

application.prompt: We have an English ___ from 9:00 to 9:40. (lesson / breakfast)
application.solution: lesson。解析：9:00 到 9:40 的课程是一节英语课。

grammar: n. 冰。表示冰这种物质时通常作不可数名词；表达数量时可用 a piece/cube of ice。
collocations: a piece of ice；an ice cube；ice cream
commonMistake: 泛指冰时 ice 通常不加 a 或复数 -s；数冰块时说 ice cubes，不说 two ices。

example.english: Put two ice cubes in the water, please.
example.chinese: 请在水里放两块冰。

application.prompt: When water freezes, it becomes ___. (ice / steam)
application.solution: ice。解析：水冻结后变成冰。
